correctness.rationale: The Galois-equivariant even-subset quotient is symplectic of dimension eight, and finite étale descent distinguishes invariant subspaces from fixed vectors. The pullback of a Lagrangian is a binary self-dual length-ten code containing the all-one word. An independent reproduction constructed 945 codes from pairings and 1350 from a paired coordinate pair and the 30 relabelings of the affine length-eight Hamming code on the remaining positions. These codes are distinct and self-dual, and 945+1350 equals the count (2+1)(4+1)(8+1)(16+1), so this is exhaustive without the frozen row-reduction or extension algorithm. Applying the permutations and comparing directly to RESULT.md confirms both columns in every row. As another check, c cycles give 2^(c-2) fixed two-torsion classes if any length is odd and 2^(c-1) otherwise: take even unions of cycles modulo complement; an even vector cannot map to its complement because a complement-swapped vector has weight five. Maximal Weil isotropy gives the descended principal polarization, and the kernel order, hence degree, is 16.
residual_risks: No universal realizability at each field size or Jacobian characterization of the quotients is asserted.
